description: Deterministic refusal-gate patterns for engage-apothecary. Each category contains regex-like patterns (case-insensitive) matched against user input at preflight. ANY match HALTs the skill with the category's redirect message. False positives are acceptable; false negatives are not — patterns deliberately over-match rather than under-match. NOT a content classifier — pattern-matching only.

dosing.description: Inputs asking for medication dose calculations or pediatric/geriatric/renal/hepatic dose adjustments.
dosing.redirect: For dosing decisions, consult a licensed clinician, a current drug reference (e.g., your institutional formulary), and the manufacturer's prescribing information. engage-apothecary does not produce dosing recommendations under any flag.

prescribing.description: Inputs asking for a prescribing decision (which drug to prescribe, prescription writing, agent selection for a specific patient).
prescribing.redirect: For prescribing decisions, consult a licensed clinician with the patient in front of them. engage-apothecary does not produce prescribing recommendations under any flag.

individualizedCare.description: Inputs asking about a specific patient or asking for individualized treatment recommendations.
patterns: \bwhat should I do for (this patient|my patient|him|her|them)\b
individualizedCare.redirect: For individualized patient care, consult a licensed clinician. engage-apothecary teaches differential reasoning on de-identified educational hypotheticals — not treatment recommendations for individual patients. Reframe as a hypothetical (e.g., 'a 45-year-old with X') and re-invoke.

patientIdentifying.description: Inputs containing patient names, dates of birth, medical record numbers, specific clinic/hospital identifiers, or specific dates of care.
patterns: \bat (Mass General|Mayo Clinic|Cleveland Clinic|Johns Hopkins|Stanford|UCSF|NYU Langone|Mount Sinai|Brigham and Women|Massachusetts General)\b
patientIdentifying.redirect: Do not share patient-identifying information. Reframe as a de-identified hypothetical (e.g., 'a 45-year-old with X') and re-invoke. engage-apothecary does not accept patient-identifying details under any flag.

acuteSymptom.description: Inputs reporting acute, ongoing, or just-occurring symptoms — phrased as a real situation rather than a hypothetical case.
patterns: \bI am having .* (chest pain|trouble breathing|severe headache|shortness of breath|stroke symptoms)\b
\bI'?m having .* (chest pain|trouble breathing|severe headache|shortness of breath|stroke symptoms)\b
acuteSymptom.redirect: For acute symptoms, call emergency services (911 / your local equivalent) or seek immediate clinical care. Do not use a learning tool for acute presentations. engage-apothecary is for educational reasoning on hypothetical cases — never for acute symptoms in real time.
